integrity: Mathematical proof covers the infinite parameter range; two finite reproducibility checkers are corroboration only. No invented certification, authorship or independent verification.
limitations: Only ordinary undirected cycle factors of length at least three; pure equality-and-adjacency rank-three logic. The proof covers every dimension but not richer signatures, counting logic, arbitrary products or higher ranks. Historical priority is not exhaustive.
title: Eight three-round theories of Cartesian products of finite cycles
